g.text: $ after (epic/379 59f96d0): bootstrap-labels --dry-run, live
$ uv run python tools/sdlc.py bootstrap-labels --dry-run
would run: gh label create sdlc:triage --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color FBCA04 --description SDLC: agent's
move - new or being groomed --force
would run: gh label create sdlc:needs-info --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color D93F0B --description SDLC:
waiting for the poster to answer questions --force
would run: gh label create sdlc:prd-review --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color 1D76DB --description SDLC: PRD
posted, waiting for the poster's sign-off --force
would run: gh label create sdlc:diagnosis-review --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color 1D76DB --description SDLC:
bug diagnosis posted, waiting for sign-off --force
would run: gh label create sdlc:approved --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color 0E8A16 --description SDLC: PRD or
diagnosis signed off, ready to plan --force
would run: gh label create sdlc:planned --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color 5319E7 --description SDLC: plan
reviewed by Claude + Codex; subtasks and slices created --force
would run: gh label create sdlc:in-progress --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color FBCA04 --description SDLC: the
epic's slices are being built (work-slice) --force
would run: gh label create sdlc:demo-review --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color 1D76DB --description SDLC:
milestone demo posted, waiting for the poster (reserved) --force
would run: gh label create sdlc:done --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color 0E8A16 --description SDLC: shipped and
accepted (reserved) --force
would run: gh label create sdlc:escalated --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color B60205 --description SDLC: a
human is needed (no consensus, or the agent is stuck) --force
would run: gh label create sdlc:waiting --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color C5DEF5 --description SDLC: waiting
for another epic's milestone to ship to main (`wait`) --force
would run: gh label create plan:subtask --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color C5DEF5 --description SDLC plan: a
subtask of an epic; its slices are sub-issues --force
would run: gh label create plan:slice --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color BFD4F2 --description SDLC plan: one
unit of work, one agent session --force
would run: gh label create complexity:routine --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color C2E0C6 --description SDLC
plan: a clear pattern to follow, little design --force
would run: gh label create complexity:judgment --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color FEF2C0 --description SDLC
plan: real design choices, safety or the evidence path --force
would run: gh label create tech-debt --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color D4C5F9 --description SDLC:
non-blocking work found while building, worked in the debt epic --force
would run: gh label create complexity:novel --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color F9D0C4 --description SDLC plan:
unknowns that need investigating first --force
would run: gh label create lane:quick --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color C2E0C6 --description SDLC: a small,
safe change built from one approved brief (work-slice --quick) --force
would run: gh label create lane:debt --repo jeromebanks/twiddle --color D4C5F9 --description SDLC: the debt
epic - every open tech-debt issue is its sub-issue (debt-epic) --force
[exit 0]
